architectures.name: Wireless Pressure Sensor Implant
architectures.mechanism: A miniature pressure sensor is implanted near the CSF shunt, transmitting pressure data wirelessly to a receiver for real-time monitoring.

structure.sensor: Miniature pressure sensor with wireless transmitter
structure.receiver: External receiver with display and alarm system

architectures.control_logic: Sensor transmits pressure data to receiver, which displays and alarms if pressure exceeds set threshold.
architectures.expected_technical_effect: Real-time monitoring of CSF pressure, enabling early detection of shunt malfunction.
architectures.failure_mode: Sensor failure, wireless transmission failure, or receiver malfunction.
architectures.manufacturing_implication: High-precision manufacturing required for sensor and receiver components.
architectures.regulatory_implication: Class III medical device, requiring FDA clearance and regular inspections.
